title: When I went back to the reeve after the bug above, he said 'He told me himself, in his way. I'd rather have heard it from you first' (implying the priest told him) -- but the priest's own line moments earlier was 'I'll say nothing to the reeve. You will have to, in the end.' The two NPCs give directly contradictory accounts of who informed whom.
where: Last Light Square / talk to reeve (option: about the promise I broke)
